newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes lower on overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes lower on overseas trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished lower against its U.S. counterpart on Saturday, dealers said, reflecting the greenback's strength in overseas markets.
The local unit closed at its intraday low of T$27.580, off a high of T$27.567, against Friday's finish of T$27.572. Turnover was US$38 million in the shortened Saturday session.
With general expectations of another Federal Reserve interest rate rise supporting a stronger U.S. dollar, the local currency was expected to follow the overseas trend next week, dealers said.
But they said continued inflows of foreign equity funds into the island's red-hot stock market would ease the Taiwan dollar's depreciating trend.
The central bank said on Friday the inflow of foreign funds totalled US$1.38 billion in March, up from US$1.31 billion in February.
A range of T$27.55-65 was seen for next week.
